memberdef.name: MachOBindEntry

briefdescription.para: MachOBindEntry encapsulates the current state in the decompression of binding opcodes.

detaileddescription.para: This allows you to iterate through the compressed table of bindings using: Error Err = Error::success(); for (const llvm::object::MachOBindEntry &Entry : Obj->bindTable(&Err)) { } if (Err) { report error ...
